title: COMPX361 · Test 1
subtitle: Formal Languages and Computability
description:
Section 1 (DFSAs and regular languages) and Section 2 (Turing machines and computability) of the COMPX361 notes — FSA1–FSA6 and TM1–TM2. Every question cites the file and the numbered section it came from.

**Test format:** in person, pen on paper. **No cheat sheet and no calculator.** The Cheat sheet page is therefore a revision sheet, not something you can take in — every formula and definition in the pack is on it so you can drill from paper, but you will be reproducing all of it from memory on the day.

Every automaton is given as a **transition table inside the question**, never as a reference to a diagram in the notes, so nothing here needs the PDFs open to attempt.

source.label: 8 lecture-note PDFs (43 pages), COMPUTATION Sections 1–2
source.detail: Typeset course notes rather than slides. Section 1 covers strings, formal languages, regular expressions, DFSAs, NFSAs, the subset method, transition graphs and Kleene's Theorem, closure properties, the dual machine, minimisation and the Pumping Lemma. Section 2 covers Turing machines, configurations, halting and computability up to the Church–Turing thesis. The notes refer to a companion text, *Finite Automata*, for proofs they omit; nothing from that text is examined here and nothing from it is in this pack.
